title: Reader
subtitle: Read stories at your level, or your own PDFs and photos, and tap any word you don't know

home.removeBody: It leaves your reading list. Your place in it is kept if you add it back.

first.pick: A good first story for you
first.privacy: Only you can see what you upload.

upload.heading: Add something to read
upload.dropzone: Drop a PDF or a photo here, or click to choose
upload.hint: PDF up to 300MB · photo up to 10MB
upload.languageHint: Used for word meanings and pronunciation

duplicate.title: You already have this file
duplicate.body: Continue where you left off. A new copy starts again from page 1.

mode.label: How should we read it?
mode.textHint: Fast and free. Works with any PDF that has real text.
mode.ocrHint: Also reads scanned pages and photos, one page at a time.
mode.imageNote: A photo always needs scan reading.
mode.imageNeedsPro: Reading a photo is a Pro feature. On the free plan, upload a PDF that has real text.
mode.pagesHint: Ready at once. The PDF is shown exactly as it is — nothing is converted.

pdf.title: Read a PDF
pdf.subtitle: Open a PDF exactly as it was laid out and tap any word you don't know
pdf.heading: Open a PDF
pdf.dropzone: Drop a PDF here, or click to choose
pdf.hint: Stays on your device — nothing is uploaded

notes.label: Your note
notes.placeholder: What do you want to remember about this?
notes.empty: No notes yet. Select any text on a page and choose Note, or add one for the page you are on.

loading.hint: Large books stream page by page, so reading can start before all of it has arrived.

audio.reading: Finding which page each recording belongs to…
audio.noIndex: This book does not say which page each recording is on, so they are listed by number.
audio.subtitlesRule_one: Each recording’s subtitles open after you hear it in full once, without skipping ahead.
audio.subtitlesRule_other: Each recording’s subtitles open after you hear it in full {{required}} times, without skipping ahead.

write.hint: Click anywhere on the page to write. Click a blank (……) to fill it in.
write.loadFailed: What you wrote on this book could not be loaded.
write.editingHint: Applies to this box, and to the next one you add.
write.empty: Nothing written yet. Turn on Write and click a page.

hints.arrow: Drag from one thing to another to draw an arrow.
hints.box: Drag to draw a box around anything.
hints.stamp: Click where the mark should go.
hints.mark: Drag to move it, or drag a round handle to reshape it. Delete removes it.
hints.highlight: Click the option you choose to underline it; drag across words to mark a phrase.

write.background: Background — covers the print under the text

settings.tapToSpeakHint: A click plays the word instead of opening it. The Translate button appears under the word you clicked.

video.pick: Pick a video below to watch it next to the page.
video.unavailable: This video could not be loaded.

words.empty: Tap any word on a page to see its meaning. Every word you look up is kept here, ready to turn into flashcards.

ocr.pageWorkingBody: This page is an image, so we are reading its words. As soon as they are ready, every word becomes clickable and this window closes by itself.
ocr.proHint: This page is a scan. With Pro, every word on a scanned page becomes clickable.
ocr.pageLockedFree: PDFs with real text are completely free — every word is clickable.
ocr.pageLockedScan: In scanned (image) PDFs, the first {{free}} pages you open are free. Upgrade to Pro to make every page of this book clickable.

view.handHint: Drag the page to move around it. A simple click still opens any word. To select a phrase, pick the arrow.

cheatsheet.title: Cheatsheet
cheatsheet.subtitle: {{language}} grammar, verbs and words
cheatsheet.search: Search a rule, a word, a verb…
cheatsheet.empty: The cheatsheet for this language is not ready yet.

library.heading: Your documents
library.emptyBody: Add a PDF or a photo of a page and it will appear here, ready to read.
library.deleteBody: The text and your reading position will be removed. This cannot be undone.

processing.heading: Getting your text ready
processing.hint: A scanned document takes longer, because each page has to be read as an image.
processing.tooLong: This is taking longer than expected.

read.truncated: This page was very long, so the end was left out.
read.hint: Tap any word for its meaning, or drag across a few words to translate a phrase.

deck.title: Words from page {{n}}
deck.body: Pick the words you want to learn. The hardest ones are chosen for you.
deck.noCandidates: No new words found on this page
deck.loading: Working out which words are worth learning
